title: Correct the agy docs the checker found wrong
action: Fix the three findings in docs/history/agy-runtime/reports/agyrt-6-docs-check.md. (1) docs/config-reference.md team.agy section: the template derives team.agy from team.claude role for role (onboard/templates.rs team.agy block), every slot { kind: herding, agent: agy, description }, and herding.agents carries agy: ["agy"]; replace the example so it shows that shape (a few roles plus a note that every team.claude role is present) and drop the claude-opus, claude-fable and agy-flash agents. (2) the-agy-belt.md advisory failure line: a crash or spawn error of a child hook on SessionStart, PreInvocation, PostToolUse and Stop fails open with the neutral answer; an unreadable payload fails closed on every event with {"decision":"deny","reason":"agy-belt: unreadable hook payload: ..."} because the event is not known before the parse (hooks/agy_belt.rs handle_payload). (3) the-agy-belt.md fallback line: the second lookup is $g/../.bee/bin/bee where $g is the absolute git common dir, so it finds the main checkout's binary from a worktree. Edit only those lines. Run .bee/bin/bee knowledge check. No code comments. (4) the-agy-belt.md onboarding merge line: merge_into in onboard/agy_belt.rs parses the file and writes the whole object again, so every other key keeps its value equal as JSON and its key order, but formatting may change; replace the byte-equal wording with that.
